scope: Causal semantic diff, cross-domain effect collapse, notification idempotency, CAS reservation and repository-write reconciliation for all Fortnite monitoring domains

principles.semantic_not_file_diff: Git SHA changes only trigger inspection. User-facing changes come from canonical business facts.
principles.causal_recurrence_safe: Repeated legitimate lifecycle transitions are distinguished by subject revision and causal parent; simple replays converge to the existing change_id.
principles.canonical_before_intent: Persist the canonical fact and change record before creating a notification intent whenever possible.
principles.outbox_before_emit: Persist RESERVED in the outbox with Git compare-and-swap before any automated user notification.
principles.at_most_once: RESERVED, SENT and UNKNOWN_DELIVERY consume a notification key for automatic delivery forever unless explicit manual recovery is requested.
principles.policy_freeze: A change's notification disposition is frozen when accepted; later policy changes do not retroactively alert old silent changes.

change_detection.step_1_subject: Resolve domain, subject_key and scope_key from stable IDs.
change_detection.step_2_current_head: Read the current subject head from the derived index or reconstruct from ledger if the index is missing/divergent.
change_detection.step_3_canonical_state: Compute material before/after state from latest canonical domain data, never from file-level diff alone.
change_detection.step_4_transition: Compute state_fingerprint and transition_fingerprint using canonical normalization V2.
change_detection.step_5_replay_check: If current canonical state already equals after-state or the same transition exists against the same causal parent, no-op.
change_detection.step_6_revision: For a real new transition increment subject_revision, point causal_parent_change_id to the current head, derive stable change_id and append exactly once.
change_detection.step_7_disposition: Freeze notification_disposition using the domain policy at detection time.

recurrence_examples.ticketing: WAITLIST -> AVAILABLE -> WAITLIST creates two distinct WAITLIST occurrences because the second has a different causal parent/revision. Re-crawling either occurrence does not create another change.
recurrence_examples.service: RESOLVED -> new later incident STARTED is a new causal episode, while repeated provider polling during the same STARTED state is not.
recurrence_examples.competition: POSTPONED -> SCHEDULED(new time) are separate transitions; re-reading the same reschedule is silent.
recurrence_examples.season_pass: An official extension and a later shortening are separate revisions even if a former date value reappears.

user_effect_collapse.purpose: Prevent the same user-facing fact from notifying once from a domain ledger and again from its mirror/projection.
user_effect_collapse.causal_anchor: Use the earliest material domain change that caused the current user-facing effect. Mirrored PHYSICAL_ACCESS/TICKETING/CALENDAR_PROJECTION changes reference it through causal_source_change_ids when possible.
user_effect_collapse.projection_rule: CALENDAR_PROJECTION never creates a second notification when causal_source_change_ids point to an already eligible/notified underlying change. It may notify only for a material calendar-only effect not represented by another canonical domain change.
user_effect_collapse.ticket_access_rule: Ticketing and physical-access transitions that represent the same access-route effect should share one user_effect_id and one notification intent.
user_effect_collapse.evidence_merge: A second official source confirming the same supported effect enriches evidence but does not create another user_effect notification.

notification_disposition.SILENT_POLICY: Material history but domain policy says silent; never becomes retroactively eligible from a policy change.
notification_disposition.ELIGIBLE_NOW: May enter outbox immediately after canonical/change persistence and all gates pass.
notification_disposition.ELIGIBLE_WHEN_DUE: Future reminder/condition. Do not create/reserve outbox intent until due and revalidated.
notification_disposition.CONDITION_BLOCKED: Potentially useful but current participant/access/deadline condition is false; no outbox intent.
notification_disposition.STALE: Out-of-order or superseded evidence; retain history when useful but never notify.

required_all: accepted material change or due reminder exists
condition still true at send time
quiet-hours handling still leaves it actionable
never_notify_for: taxonomy/lore enrichment without actionable future impact
mirror/projection of an already-notified causal change

outbox_protocol.reserve: Append intent if absent + RESERVED delivery event, then Git update using the freshly fetched SHA.
outbox_protocol.cas_conflict: Discard stale payload, fresh-fetch, and re-evaluate. If key is now consumed, stop. If still absent and conditions remain true, a newly rebuilt CAS attempt is allowed.
outbox_protocol.emit: Only after successful canonical RESERVED persistence.
outbox_protocol.confirm: After emission append SENT via fresh CAS. Failure to persist SENT never permits resend because RESERVED already consumed the key.
outbox_protocol.recovery: After 30 minutes a stale RESERVED without SENT becomes UNKNOWN_DELIVERY via append-only event and stays consumed.
outbox_protocol.manual_replay: Never automatic. Requires explicit intervention and a distinct manual_replay_id/audit event.

coalescing.rule: Group related pre-reservation changes when one concise alert better represents the same user effect.
good_examples: season launch exact time + explicitly linked downtime
never_merge: two distinct lifecycle occurrences merely sharing a value
coalescing.freeze: Once RESERVED, group membership and payload are immutable. Later material changes receive another logical effect/intent if eligible.

planned_reminders.rule: Never reserve future notifications hours/days early.
planned_reminders.due_flow: At trigger time fresh-read canonical domain state; verify version/condition/future action; build effect/key; reserve via outbox CAS; emit once.
planned_reminders.invalidated_before_due: No outbox intent is created, so there is nothing to retry or suppress later.

flap_and_source_guard.rule: Do not create transitions from page failures, stale caches or weaker contradictory sources.
flap_and_source_guard.strong_direct_transition: A direct authoritative source can create an immediate material transition.
flap_and_source_guard.weak_or_ambiguous: Keep prior state and mark observation inconclusive/ledger-only until confirmed; do not oscillate canonical state merely to match a transient weak signal.
flap_and_source_guard.same_effect_multi_source: Merge evidence into the existing effect/change where semantically appropriate, never alert once per source.

write_idempotency.fresh_sha: Every Git update/delete requires a fresh blob SHA for that exact path immediately before write.
write_idempotency.canonical_ledgers: No write for semantically identical state even if checked_at changes.
write_idempotency.ics: Use projected_business_fingerprint; formatting/header/DTSTAMP-only changes never increment SEQUENCE.
write_idempotency.unknown_commit: Fresh-fetch target and compare desired fingerprint before any retry.
write_idempotency.change_and_outbox: Never recursively create a user-facing change because the change ledger, outbox or derived index itself changed.

reconciliation.index: fortnite-change-index-france.json is derived. Rebuild from ledger+outbox on divergence.
reconciliation.outbox: Every intent must reference existing change_ids or an explicitly identified due reminder effect. consumed_keys must be exactly derivable from RESERVED/SENT/UNKNOWN_DELIVERY events.
reconciliation.causal_chain: Each subject revision >1 must point to the immediately preceding revision unless an archive checkpoint explicitly bridges it.
reconciliation.unknown_delivery: Surface only for audit/diagnostics, never as a trigger to resend.
reconciliation.orphan_write: If Git may have succeeded, inspect canonical target and repair write audit state rather than replaying blindly.

ics_policy.header_only: Add on next real business write only; no SEQUENCE increment for headers alone.
ics_policy.privacy: Never serialize outbox intent IDs, reservation IDs, delivery states or notification payload snapshots into public ICS.
